14: public class FieldNamingPolicyTest {
15:   @Test
16:   public void testSeparateCamelCase() {
17:     // Map from original -> expected
18:     String[][] argumentPairs =  {
19:       { "a", "a" },
20:       { "ab", "ab" },
21:       { "Ab", "Ab" },
22:       { "aB", "a_B" },
23:       { "AB", "A_B" },
24:       { "A_B", "A__B" },
25:       { "firstSecondThird", "first_Second_Third" },
26:       { "__", "__" },
27:       { "_123", "_123" }
28:     };
29: 
30:     for (String[] pair : argumentPairs) {
31:       assertEquals(pair[1], FieldNamingPolicy.separateCamelCase(pair[0], '_'));
32:     }
33:   }
34: 
35:   @Test
36:   public void testUpperCaseFirstLetter() {
37:     // Map from original -> expected
38:     String[][] argumentPairs =  {
39:       { "a", "A" },
40:       { "ab", "Ab" },
41:       { "AB", "AB" },
42:       { "_a", "_A" },
43:       { "_ab", "_Ab" },
44:       { "__", "__" },
45:       { "_1", "_1" },
46:       // Not a letter, but has uppercase variant (should not be uppercased)
47:       // See https://github.com/google/gson/issues/1965
48:       { "\u2170", "\u2170" },
49:       { "_\u2170", "_\u2170" },
50:       { "\u2170a", "\u2170A" },
51:     };
52: 
53:     for (String[] pair : argumentPairs) {
54:       assertEquals(pair[1], FieldNamingPolicy.upperCaseFirstLetter(pair[0]));
55:     }
56:   }

60:    */

62:   public void testUpperCasingLocaleIndependent() throws Exception {
63:     class Dummy {
64:       @SuppressWarnings("unused")
65:       int i;
66:     }

68:     FieldNamingPolicy[] policies = {
69:       FieldNamingPolicy.UPPER_CAMEL_CASE,
